newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-DONG JIONG TESTED AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-DONG JIONG TESTED AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Dong Jiong, the number one seed from China, had a surprisingly tough struggle before securing a place in the last 16 of the world badminton championships on Wednesday.
The All-England champion was held at 11-11 in the first game by Russia's Pavel Uvarov before going on to take the opener 15-11.
In the second, with 30-year-old Uvarov displaying terrific defence, Dong trailed 2-4 before surging ahead to take command at 8-4 and going on to win 15-11 15-5.
Defending champion, Heryanto Arbi, from Indonesia, cruised through 15-4 15-11 against Canadian Mike Beres.
Women's titleholder and top seed, China's Ye Zhaoying, took just 11 minutes to defeat Australia's Commonwealth Games champion, Lisa Campbell 11-1 11-1.
All the seeds survived early second round action, with only Indonesia's Cindana being pushed to a deciding game by Russian-born Swede, Marina Andrievskaya.
Andrievskaya, with her left thigh heavily strapped, saved three match points against the number 16 seed before taking the second game 12-11.
But she could not maintain the pressure in the third and Cindana claimed a last 16 meeting with Ye, winning 11-7 11-12 11-3.
